senses.gloss: (II)--a याज्ञिय god. Br. II. ३६. ३३.
(III)--a मुहूर्त of the night. Br. III. 3. ४२.
(IV)--a Sukha god. Br. IV. 1. १८.
(V)--a son of हविर्धान. M. 4. ४५.
(VI)--an आदित्य. M. 6. 4.
(VII)--the father of इलिना, (s.v.). M. ४९. 9. [page३-014+ २६]
(VIII)--a Vasu; a son of Dharma and सुदेवी. M. १७१. ४७.
(IX)--the agent of a class of devas. वा. १०. ७२.

(X)--the son of सुरेणु and Vivasvan; ill-treated by stepmother छाया, was about to kick her when she cursed him that he would lose his leg; he became Dharma- राज, lord of पितृस् and Protector of the world. वा. ८४. २२, ५६-61.
(XI)--a mukhya गण. वा. १००. १८.
--prescriptions. वा. १०४. १४.

--the twelve devas born of यज्ञ and दक्षिणा and waited on हरियज्ञ;
1: भा. I. 3. १२; VIII. 1. १८.
they are Yadu, ययाति, Vivadha, स्रासत, Mati, विभास, Kratu, प्रयाति, विश्रुत, Dyuti, वायव्य and Samyama,
2: Br. II. 9. ४५; १३. ८९-90; वा. १०. २०; ३१. 3, 6-7.
born in the epoch of स्वायम्- bhuva Manu.
3: M. 9. 3; ५१. ४०; Vi. I. 7. २१; १२. १२.
[page३-029+ २४]
--an eastern tribe. M. ११४. ४४.
--servants of Yama. वा. ११०. ४५.
--a Bhairava god. Br. IV. २०. ८२.

--met विष्णु du1tas at the death of अजामिल, and argued that punishment depended on the character of one's action, and that अजामिल a Brahmana deserved punish- ment for having forsaken his स्वधर्म and led an evil life with a दासि। Overpowered by Hari's दूतस्, they reported [page३-015+ २६] to Yama (s.v.) and wanted to know the truth of the matter. Instructed by Yama as knower of Dharma and ordained by Hari, his messengers cherished Hari's glory, and did not go near his devotees. भा. VI. 1. २०, ४०. ६८; 3. १०-34.
--belong to कौशिक gotra. Br. III. ६६. ७२; वा. ९१. १००.
--a region of the जम्बुद्वीप; here is Dutimat, a Mt. वा. ४८. १४, १९.
--the kingdom of Dharma. वा. १०६. २०; १०८. 3; Vi. V. २१. ३०.
--(किण्कर): a servant of Yama with a noose. Vi. III. 7. १३, १९.
--the offering to शिव at the प्रभास hill. वा. १०८. २३; ११०. ३८.
--of कौशिक gotra. वा. ९१. ९८.
--a दानव king. Br. IV. २९. १२४.
--a name of कृष्ण. Br. III. ३६. २८.
--also known as Anuparvatam, west of the लौहिती and the Sindhu. वा. ६९. २४१.
--of kings; to punish impartially. M. २२६. 4. [page३-016+ ४४]
taken to the abode of Yama in two or three मुहूर्तस् covering about ९९००० yoja- nas; tortures in. भा. III. ३०. २०-28.
--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८२.
--a daughter of Vivasvan (सूर्य-वि। प्।) and सम्ज्ञा; also यमुना. भा. VI. 6. ४०: VIII. १३. 9: Br. III. ५९. ३८; Vi. III. 2. 2.
--one of the ten wives of Dharma and mother of नागवीथि. M. 5. १५; वा. ६६. 2.

(I)--(कालिन्दी) (R.) in भारतवर्ष from the हिमालयस्; a divine stream.
1: भा. V. १९. १८; वा. ४५. ९५.
A महानदी.
2: Ib. १०४. ५०.
Here Vidura met Uddhava;
3: भा. III. 1. २४; 2. २७; IV. 2. ३५.
the co-wives who administered poison to Citraketu's son, had a purificatory bath in; Citraketu, who was initiated into the विद्या by नारद had his preli- minary bath in this river.
4: Ib. VI. १६. १४ and १६.
On its banks Vaivasvata Manu performed तपस् for progeny, and Bharata celebrated his horse sacrifice. On its banks stands Madhuvana near बृण्दावन. कृष्ण, his brother, and others played there and once defeated the Asura Vatsa. Gopi girls bathed there as part of the कात्ययनी व्रतम्। Nanda used to bathe here.
5: Ib. IX, 2. 1; 4. ३०; २०. २५; X. ११. ३६-43; २२. 2, 6, ३६; २८. 1.
Immersed in its waters Saubhari performed penance. Poisoned by the कालीय; कृष्ण sent away the reptile to the sea and made its waters drinkable; unapproachable to गरुड by a curse of Saubhari.
6: Ib. IX. 6. ३९; X. १५. ४७-8; १६. 4, ६०-7; १७. 8-११.
अक्रूर who took कृष्ण and राम to मथुरा, had his bath on the way in this river. Inside the waters he saw both कृष्ण and राम; also saw Hari on the शेष. Here कृष्ण killed Hamsa.
7: Ib. X. ३९. ३८-46; ७६. 2 [8]; ७८. [1).
On its bank जरासन्ध encamped to besiege मथुरा. Here कृष्ण had his अवभृत after the horse sacrifice. Here again कृष्ण and अर्जुण met कालिन्दी.
8: Ib. X. [५० (v) 6 and १४]; ८९. ६३ [4]; ५८. १६-7.
During his pilgrimage [page३-017+ ४३] बलराम visited this.
9: Ib. X. ७८. २०.
Was in floods when Vasudeva crossed it for Gokula with the new born babe, कृष्ण.
१०: Ib. X. 3. ५०.
Sacred for श्राद्ध; sometimes too hot and sometimes too cold; daughter of मार्ताण्ड and सम्ज्ञा and sister of Yama; got changed into a sacred river. On its northern bank is प्रयागा (प्रतिष्ठान).
११: Br. II. १६. २५; III. १३. ७१-2; ५९. २३ and ८३; ६६. २१; ७३. ११७; IV. १५. २३; M. ११. 4, ३९; १०४. १९; १०८. २२; वा. ७७. ६९-70.
Sacred to मृगावती; sacred to the पितृस्;
१२: M. १३. ४०.
a boundary of the kingdom of पितृस्;
१३: Ib. २२. २०.
in the chariot of त्रिपुरारि;
१४: Ib. ११०. 5; ११४. २१; १३३. २३; १६३. ६१; २३९. १८.
one of the १६ wives of हव्यवाहन (fire)
१५: Ib. ५१. १३; वा. २९. १३.
forms the left side of the Veda;
१६: Ib. १०४. ७७; १०८. ७९.
daughter of सुरेणु and सूर्य;
१७: Ib. ५८. ८८; ८४. २२.
a sacred river.
१८: Br. II. १२. १४; वा. ९८. ११७; Vi. III. १४. १८; V. 3. १८; 7. 7ff; १८. ३३.

(II)--(personified) sister of Yama. Once बलराम invited her for watersports, and got enraged at her delay. Hence he dragged her by means of his plough through बृण्दावन्. This changed her course; then she prayed for mercy which was granted. She presented राम with clothes and jewels. Even now the change in the course is noticeable. भा. X. 3. ५०; Ib. ch. ६५ (whole); Vi. V. २५. 8-११, VI. 8. ३१.
--on its north bank was situated प्रतिष्ठान Va1. ९१. ५०.
--twins--Nakula and Sahadeva. भा. I. १०. 9; Vi. V. ३५. २८; ३८. ९१.
--residents of Maharloka; by turns go to Janaloka; born of प्रजापति. Br. IV. 2. ५१-55.

--one of the wives of तार्क्ष्य and mother of locusts (शलभस्);
1: भा. VI. 6. २१.
a शक्ति.
2: Br. IV. ४४. ७५.
--a tribe. भा. I. १०. ३४.
--a कश्यप and a त्रयार्षेय. M. १९९. १३.
--a group of नाडिस् emitting dew from the sun. Br. II. २४. २८.
